summary.tldr: Requires the CRA to report tax evasion convictions and tax gap statistics, and to share tax gap data with the Parliamentary Budget Officer.
what_it_does: Adds a detailed list of all tax evasion convictions, including a separate list for international tax evasion, to the CRA annual report.
Requires the CRA annual report to include tax gap statistics every three years, starting three years after the new rule takes effect.
Defines the tax gap as tax that should have been assessed on undeclared income, plus the difference between tax assessed and tax collected.
Requires the Minister to collect, compile, analyse and summarise tax gap statistics for individuals, corporations by size, and resident trusts.
Requires the Minister to give the Parliamentary Budget Officer the tax gap data, plus any extra data the Officer says is relevant.
summary.background: It amends the Canada Revenue Agency Act. The new reporting rules apply to the CRA’s annual report to the Minister of National Revenue.
